label: Edge open unless a bridge on it is damaged to a closing state

inputs.name: damage
inputs.description: The damage state of every bridge whose `edge` is this edge, on the damage scale the closure policy is written for: zero, one or several parents.

damage_scale.description: The damage-state quantity the closure policy reads.

usable_states.description: The damage states in which a bridge stays open to traffic.

description: Each bridge sits on one edge (Bridge.edge). The edge is open only if every bridge on it is in a damage state its closure policy keeps open, the parameter set's usable_states; an edge with no bridge is always open, as only bridges are fragile in this library. A roadway fragility would add a second input here.
